strict_gate: Every warmup and measured job must reproduce the captured native waveform hash and shape; snapshot hashes immutable
timed_scope: Isolated native waveform call through GPU1 completion; main GPU has no concurrent model work; same tokens/cache/RNG restored before each job

variants.native_main: native call on the already-used main thread
variants.fresh_worker: new wave thread for every measured job
variants.warm_worker: one thread retained through two warmup jobs and seven measured jobs per snapshot

limits: Compute diagnostic, not full pipeline or playback latency
GPU active from other test calls: does not isolate long device-idle wakeup effects
CPU snapshot restoration and thread creation excluded from native-call elapsed; queue/API overhead recorded separately
Existing waveform algorithm and same two GPUs; no new PD or quality claim
